text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
My body feels kind of heavy... It's hard 
to move...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fatigue... or is she feeling unwell? I 
wonder what could have happened...
choice_data_list:
You did that all-you-can-eat cake stream, 
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh!? ...Even though it was just that 
much...?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... It was so delicious, I just 
couldn't help it...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Anyway, this won't do. I have to work 
off everything I ate...!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I have to return the love I've received, 
so let's get your body back into top shape 
so you can give it your all!"

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Loves-chan, great work on training! It 
looks like things have been super tough 
lately."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but having everyone's love is what 
keeps me going!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You devoted herself to training 
and successfully managed to lose weight.
